verdict.rationale: Oneleet is a compliance and security platform, so built-in security awareness training is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence pack never mentions training modules, assignment at hire, completion tracking, or using training records as audit evidence. Policy publishing, MDM and Fieldwork evidence collection are adjacent features and do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an operations lead, security awareness training is built in — assigned on hire, tracked to completion, and accepted as audit evidence
